Clint Carlson decreased its stake in Goldman Sachs Group Inc (GS) by 6.49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Carlson Capital LP sold 7,605 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.36% with the market. The hedge fund run by Clint Carlson held 109,548 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $27.59M, down from 117,153 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carlson Capital LP who had been investing in Goldman Sachs Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $87.60B market cap company.
